objective: Run the first live end-to-end Rhino CAD MCP proof of concept after the user-scope rhino-cad registration fix, deliberately validating session-scope tool injection from outside the project root and then exercising isolated document creation, CAD mutation, validation, capture, save, and Git reporting without modifying the system during the run.
instructions: This is an observational live rerun. Do not fix, refactor, reconfigure, or improve any bridge, MCP, runtime, orientation, or Claude configuration during the run. Record issues instead.

Start this Claude Code session from /Users/nes, not from the project root, specifically to prove the new user-scope rhino-cad registration makes the MCP tools available independent of session starting directory.
Prerequisite: Rhino 8 must already be running. If Rhino is not running, STOP at preflight and record that prerequisite failure. Do not launch or reconfigure Rhino during this baseline.
Invoke the rhino-chatgpt-orientation skill in operator mode first and apply the fresh orientation silently.
Then work in /Users/nes/bin/mcp/rhino-cad-mcp. From clean up-to-date main, fetch/pull --ff-only, discover this request, and run ./exchange.sh prepare bridge-phase16-001.

Create and maintain .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase16-001/session-log.json from before MCP discovery onward. For each stage record UTC timestamp, stage, outcome, elapsed_seconds when measurable, human_intervention_required, retries, tool used, and concise notes.

Record session facts: Claude Code version/model, session starting directory, effective project directory, orientation skill result, local/base commit, git cleanliness, claude mcp get rhino-cad output summary, and whether rhino-cad appears in the current session's MCP/tool registry.

Before any Rhino mutation, prove session-scope MCP visibility using the current Claude session's own tool discovery surface. Record visible rhino-cad tool names and compare to source inventory. If rhino-cad is still absent, STOP and record the blocker; do not change config.
Run non-mutating Rhino preflight using rhino_status and rhino_list_documents. Record structured results, reachable Rhino instance IDs, document IDs, timings, and any target ambiguity.

Protect all existing user work. Create a dedicated new document using rhino_create_document named RHINO_CHATGPT_BRIDGE_POC_003. If safe isolation cannot be demonstrated, STOP before geometry mutation.

After creation, list documents again and explicitly identify the new document ID. Activate/target the new document using the existing MCP targeting mechanism if necessary. Confirm by inspecting the new document and proving it is empty before mutation.

Create a deterministic three-solid assembly in the isolated POC document: rectangular base, vertical cylindrical pedestal, and smaller top block/cap. Use sensible dimensions in document units. Prefer a single deterministic rhino_run or transaction only if its target behavior is explicit and safe.

Create a dedicated layer named BRIDGE_POC_003 if supported. Put all three objects on it. Set object names and metadata/user strings including role, created_by=bridge-phase16-001, revision=1, and operation_id. Read all metadata back.
Validate each object using rhino_validate or equivalent. Record GUID, object type, validity, solid/manifold state, naked edges if returned, bbox, area, volume, and metadata.
Run rhino_validate_assembly. Record invalid/non-solid IDs, duplicates, metadata gaps, interference results, inconclusive checks, and overall interpretation without overstating success.

Capture visual evidence with the strongest existing capture surface. Prefer rhino_capture_views or rhino_visual_qa with one isometric and at least one orthographic/secondary view. Preserve PNG/contact sheet, manifest JSON, and scene archive if produced. Copy resulting evidence into .bridge/artifacts/bridge-phase16-001/ without altering contents if the MCP writes elsewhere.

Save the isolated POC document with rhino_save_as to a deterministic new path under .bridge/artifacts/bridge-phase16-001/ or another safe non-existing path, then preserve/copy the verified .3dm into the artifact directory. Record file path, file size, verification/readback counts, IDs, bounds, and active-document path behavior.
Re-inspect the POC document after save. Record final document ID, active state, object count, layer count, object GUIDs, and whether the three solids remain valid.
Do not close/delete the POC document automatically. Report its final live state and saved path so the user can inspect it manually.

Create .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase16-001/workflow-assessment.json with: architecture_path_observed, stage_metrics, session_scope_validation, mcp_tool_inventory, rhino_preflight, document_isolation, cad_operations, validation_results, artifact_manifest, save_results, retries_and_errors, manual_interventions, ambiguities, friction_points, and recommendations.

Classify friction_points by severity high/medium/low and category from onboarding, git_bridge, request_protocol, branch_lifecycle, mcp_discovery, rhino_targeting, mutation_safety, tool_schema, latency_timeout, artifact_handoff, validation, reporting, or other. Include exact stage and concrete evidence.
Separate recommendations into QUICK_WINS, PROTOCOL_CHANGES, and MCP_RUNTIME_CHANGES. Do not implement recommendations.

Create .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase16-001/operator-experience.md describing what felt smooth, what was awkward, what required reasoning/manual intervention, and the top five workflow improvements ranked by impact.
Measure total elapsed time and counts of Git commands, MCP calls, retries, manual interventions, and handoff steps.

Do not modify server.py, bridge.py, runtime_ops.py, tool_support.py, snippets.py, requirements.txt, knowledge/, tests/, .mcp.json, ~/.claude.json, skill/installer/orientation files, operator.sh, exchange.sh, orient.sh, or .bridge/bridge_cli.py.
Do not install dependencies, re-register MCP servers, restart/reconfigure services, or bypass a safety failure.
Run git diff --check and verify only Phase 16 evidence/artifacts/report files are added.
Commit evidence/artifacts as the work commit and capture RESULT_COMMIT.
Create .bridge/reports/bridge-phase16-001.json with ack exactly BRIDGE-PHASE16-RHINO-LIVE-20260924-5A7C2D-OPERATOR-ACK, exact base_commit, RESULT_COMMIT, and branch operator/bridge-phase16-001.

The report summary must classify the path ChatGPT controller -> Git request -> Claude operator -> session-scope rhino-cad MCP -> rhinocode/Rhino -> isolated CAD mutation -> validation/artifacts -> Git report as COMPLETE, PARTIAL, or BLOCKED and name the first failing stage if not complete.
Run python3 .bridge/bridge_cli.py verify-report bridge-phase16-001 and require REPORT_OK.
Commit the report as the receipt commit, push operator/bridge-phase16-001, and do not merge it.
expected_outputs: .bridge/artifacts/bridge-phase16-001/ containing visual evidence and a verified saved .3dm if those stages succeed
constraints: Observation only; do not fix issues during the run.
Start Claude from /Users/nes to prove user-scope MCP availability independent of project root.
Never mutate an existing user Rhino document.
Require explicit isolated document identity before mutation.
Do not claim validation for checks that did not run.
No dependency install, config changes, service restart, force push, or merge.
Stop and record any new safety/environment blocker instead of bypassing it.
